reviews.title: Noctua for reliable quite fans!!
reviews.comment: I have used this brand consistently for most of my PC builds, they are vey good, very quite and are easy to install and provide great length of cables and accessories to make fitment perfect inside the case.  The airflow these provide seems unmatched and their longevity is great.  At full speed there is very little noise and they are somewhat more expensive, but you have to change them less often if ever!!
reviews.author: Big Deahl

reviews.title: Absolutely little monsters!
reviews.comment: Absolutely top notch bar none. You can try and argue all you like about artic Corsair etc, nothing holds a candle to these fans. Super quiet little beasts. Don’t overthink just buy them. I know they are not cheap but worth every penny.
reviews.author: Blueshirtfan

reviews.title: Pricy but worth it
reviews.comment: Pricy but great fans!  Quiet and they move a lot of air.
reviews.author: Mulaw

reviews.title: Quiet, powerful and a great upgrade
reviews.comment: I swapped out my Lian Li LCD 140mm fans for these Noctua NF-A14x25 G2 fans and I’m very happy with the change. They are noticeably quieter while still moving a lot of air. Build quality is excellent and there are no vibrations or strange noises. If you want performance and low noise instead of flashy RGB, these are a great upgrade.
reviews.author: SSL

reviews.title: Extremely quiet
reviews.comment: Works great, silent and moves a lot of air quietly and efficiently! I only wish they would make them in RGB, I use them in the front as the main intake and less efficient but RGB ones for the visible top radiator and back exhaust fans.
reviews.author: Andrew A
